newsitem.title: USA: Prime Capital sees boost to Q4 fee income.
newsitem.headline: Prime Capital sees boost to Q4 fee income.

text.p: Prime Capital Corp said Friday it expects to close soon on an asset securitization of approximately $65 million which will generate substantial fee income in the fourth quarter.
Prime Capital provides capital and specialty finance services to the health care and other industries.
The backlog of approved finance transactions "significantly exceeded" $150 million at the end of the third quarter, compared with about $66 million a year ago.
Earlier, Prime Capital reported a net loss for the third quarter of about $0.23 a share, compared with a loss a year ago of $0.17.
The third quarter loss widened due to the absence of an asset securitization and higher expenses, the company said.
